svg.text: davis_pixel - one DAVIS pixel of the 2x2 array (= davis_px without emulator, mux and pin driver)
PD is a pin so the shared emulator bank can sink current into it; the real photodiode D1 sits on the same node.
PATENT NOTE: shared-photodiode DAVIS (US9631974 / EP2795894B1) - research use; see PATENTS.md.
Cs: layout = cap_nmos_03v3 2x2 um (~16 fF). Ideal in the schematic (PDK MOS-cap model stalls ngspice).
Each pixel has its own COL (and column sink Mcol), so the 4 pixels never fight over one line.
